messages:
maria_cs: FYI we've got a customer (acme-ml) hitting 403 only on embeddings after an SSO key refresh. Generations and rerank endpoints OK.

maria_cs: Symptoms: POST /v1/embeddings -> 403, response body shows missing scope 'embeddings' in token claims. Customer says the provisioning flow didn't change.

acme_ops: Confirmed - after SSO refresh today, our app got 403s on embeddings. Attached minimal repro. Token claims show scopes but embeddings denied.

maria_cs: Repro steps the customer sent:
1) Exchange SSO code for token (their IdP)
2) Call /v1/embeddings with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> 403
3) Call /v1/generate with same token -> 200

maria_cs: They also pasted the token scopes string (redacted): "inference\u00A0embeddings rerank" (notice non-breaking space between inference and embeddings).

ethan_auth: Interesting — Do we parse scopes by splitting on ASCII whitespace/comma only? Can you paste the raw claim key name (scp vs scope vs scopes)?

acme_ops: claim key is "scp" (string). Value appears as a single string: "inference\u00A0embeddings rerank"

cory_eng: If the scp value has a NBSP (U+00A0) that might not match our ASCII-space tokenizer. We split on /[ ,]+/ currently. That would leave a token like "inference\u00A0embeddings" which doesn't match any granted scope.

ethan_auth: Right — that would explain generation (maybe uses a separate claim parsing path) vs embeddings which uses the normalized scope set. Do we have any ingress filters that normalize unicode spaces?

david_sre: Ingress sidecar (nginx-layer) has a header sanitizer that trims control chars but doesn't normalize NBSP. Could verify quickly.

ingress-bot: Notice: ingress-sidecar v1.2.2 strips ASCII-only control chars; unicode whitespace normalization added on 2025-10-08 in backlog, not released.

oncall-auth: Can someone paste a minimal curl repro we can run locally? I can iterate.

cory_eng: Reproducer (sanitized):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-1","input":"hi"}'

# If $TOKEN has scp claim with NBSP between words, server returns 403 with code 'missing:embeddings' in response.

oncall-auth: I ran a quick test with a token whose scp = "inference\u00A0embeddings rerank" and reproduced 403. Parsing leaves a single malformed token.

maria_cs: Customer asked for workaround until we patch. Any suggestions to give them?

ethan_auth: Two options: have the IdP normalize scopes (preferred), or have the app request scopes quoted or comma-separated (e.g., "inference,embeddings,rerank"). Quick temporary fix: we can accept NBSP as whitespace on the auth side, but that's a code change.

acme_ops: We can try quoting/scoping differently on our side ASAP. Will try comma-separated.

david_sre: I'll pop a hotfix to auth token parsing to treat any Unicode space category as delimiter. Patch target: auth-service and ingress normalizer. Low risk. PR incoming.

deploy-bot: CI green for auth/parse-nbsp; staging deploy scheduled.

maria_cs: Great — I'll send the workaround to the customer (comma-separated scopes) and mark as escalated.

david_sre: Patch merged to main -> will roll to prod tonight. PR #4783.

deploy-bot: Deployed ingress-sidecar v1.2.4 and auth-parser v3.7.1 to prod (canary 10%).

acme_ops: Confirmed our dev app with comma-separated scopes works now. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

maria_cs: Closing loop with customer. Will reopen if anything else shows up.
